verdict.headline: Meio da Baia Lunch
verdict.reason: Meio da Baia is worth a quick check for lunch, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide and timing are lining up well for this spot.

conversationalSummary.text: TODAY looks like a worth-checking only at Meio da Baia around lunch, but the wind angle is poor and could easily turn it choppy even if you get some wave. Given the low confidence overall, I’d check the Surfline cams first and then the MEO Beachcam for Meio da Baia—if it doesn’t look clean and punchy in the bay, skip the session. If the cams look surprisingly good, that’s your best bet from the options.

An inconsistent Baía spot that can work well when north-northwest swell reaches the bay; this is best for bodyboard sessions when the bay is clean, there is enough period and size, and the forecast shows a defined wave; 6-9s at low tide can still make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia punchy.
